notes: 0.3.36：把「云端到底有没有东西可拉」的判据从分支数换成分支树里的文件数，再加上两条体检。一、判定层：之前只看 git ls-remote --heads 数到几个分支——远端 main 还在、树却被删空了，照样被判成「有内容，只许拉取」，点拉取只会 clone 到空目录、状态原地不动，初始化推送的入口永远不出现，人就被卡死在一个什么都同步不下来的循环里（实测 Gitee 云端就是这情形：98 个提交，最后 12 个全是「删除文件」，最新提交的树里 0 个文件）。现在先数分支（0 个直接算空，不联网 fetch），有分支才临时建一个 bare 仓库 fetch --depth 1 --filter=blob:none 只取树对象，ls-tree -r 数文件，探完删掉临时目录；status 多给 remoteFiles，remoteEmpty / mode / pushAllowed / pullAllowed 和 advice 的四支说法全部改用文件数。云端「有分支但 0 文件」时 sync.ps1 用 --force-with-lease 覆盖那个空分支（树是空的，不丢数据），否则全新历史与远端无共同祖先会被 non-fast-forward 拒。二、拉取前体检：铺配置是整份 WriteAllText 覆盖，改完路径没推送就拉取，改动会被静默盖回去（备份有，但没人去翻）。现在覆盖前先比一次（本机现状归一化成占位符、CRLF 拉平成 LF、our-free-model.json 的三个时间戳字段一起置 0），不同就写 config-sync-overwrite.json，面板与控制台都提示「有 N 份配置被仓库版本覆盖（本机改动已先备份）」。三、推送后体检：扫仓库里的 settings / profile / workspace 的 json 与 yml，把不属于任何已确认根的绝对路径抓出来（换台机器就是死路径），写 config-sync-absolute-paths.json 并在面板「本机路径」卡列出来，不拦提交。四、两边都空时补上拉取门禁：以前只挡了 push，pull 还能生成脚本（拉下来还是空目录），现在没文件就直接拒并指向「推送（初始化）」。面板：本机路径卡新增两条只读提示，编辑态每个根多一个「用探测值」回填。自检按新判据重写了 7 条断言，新增 7 条 0.3.36 断言。
notesEn: 0.3.36: the criterion for "does the cloud have anything to pull" moves from branch count to the file count inside the branch tree, plus two health checks. 1) Judgement: it used to count branches with git ls-remote --heads, so a remote whose main still exists but whose tree was emptied still read as "has content, pull only": pulling produced an empty folder, the state never changed and the initialize-push entry never appeared - a dead loop where nothing can be synced (verified on Gitee: 98 commits, the last 12 all "delete file", the newest tree holds 0 files). Now it counts branches first (0 branches = empty, no fetch), then only when branches exist does it create a temporary bare repo, fetch --depth 1 --filter=blob:none for trees only and count with ls-tree -r, deleting the temp dir afterwards. status gains remoteFiles, and remoteEmpty / mode / pushAllowed / pullAllowed plus the four advice branches all use the file count. When the cloud has a branch but 0 files, sync.ps1 overwrites that empty branch with --force-with-lease (the tree is empty, nothing is lost); without it a brand-new history with no common ancestor is rejected as non-fast-forward. 2) Pre-pull check: writing configs is a whole-file WriteAllText, so editing a path and pulling before pushing silently replaced the edit (a backup existed but nobody digs through it). It now compares first (local file normalised to placeholders, CRLF flattened to LF, the three timestamp fields in our-free-model.json zeroed), and any difference lands in config-sync-overwrite.json with a panel and console notice "N config files overwritten by the repo version (local edits backed up first)". 3) Post-push check: walks the repo settings / profile / workspace json and yml files, pulls out absolute paths outside every confirmed root (dead paths on another machine), writes config-sync-absolute-paths.json and lists them in the Local paths card without blocking the commit. 4) When both sides are empty a pull gate is now added: previously only push was blocked and pull still generated a script (which pulled an empty folder anyway); with no files it is refused with a pointer to Push (initialize). Panel: the Local paths card shows two read-only notices and edit mode offers a "Detected" button per root. Selftest rewritten for the new criterion (7 assertions) plus 7 new 0.3.36 assertions.
